title: Rory and the Moonlit Fern Lagoon
verses:
The sun dipped low behind the hill,
And painted ripples in the stream,
The evening air was cool and still,
Inviting Rory to a dream.

Now Benny knelt beside the bay,
And Tilly smoothed the sandy floor,
To wash the bustling light away,
Along the quiet water shore.

Then Ricky chased a sleepy breeze,
That rustled through the clover deep,
While Psittaco among the trees,
Began to hum a song of sleep.

Above the lake where shadows glide,
Where Nia circled through the blue,
She folded wings along the tide,
And brought a breeze of silver dew.

Now Rory curled his tail around,
To make a nest of velvet green,
They settled on the mossy ground,
Within a calm and starry scene.

The gentle night begins to fall,
The shining moon is riding high,
A hush has settled over all,
Beneath the dark and tranquil sky.
